questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "deemed" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "deemed" means that the property is treated as if it were part of the estate, even though it was transferred before death.
questions.explain_zh: 「deemed」在此指的是即使財產在死亡前已轉移，仍被視為遺產的一部份。
questions.news_title_en: President signs estate- and gift-tax amendment tightening deemed-estate rules

questions.question: According to the summary, when does a property gifted to a spouse become part of the decedent's estate for tax purposes?
options: If it is given within two years before death
If it is given more than five years after death
If it is given to any relative at any time
If it is given after the decedent's will is filed
questions.explain_en: The amendment says gifts to a spouse or statutory heirs within two years before death are treated as part of the estate.
questions.explain_zh: 修正案規定，死亡前兩年內贈與給配偶或法定繼承人的財產，會被視為遺產的一部份。
questions.news_title_en: President signs estate- and gift-tax amendment tightening deemed-estate rules

questions.explain_zh: 「running hot」在文中指的是經濟成長非常快，而不是指天氣或身體發燒。
